The Housing Virtual Tour is a web‑based preview experience released by Blizzard Entertainment following the full expansion reveal of at gamescom 2025 ahead of the housing system. The virtual tour provides a "" preview as if the viewer were in-game, allowing players to browse a curated home and explore its decor themes and furnishing sets through an interactive website. It provided an early look at the housing system before it became available in‑game with patch 11.2.7. The Zillow for Warcraft promotional website features multiple builds that make use of the Housing Virtual Tour.

Huk Huk is a hozen located in Fe-Feng Village on the Wandering Isle. He is the chieftain of the Fe Feng hozen, seemingly succeeding Ruk-Ruk. When Jia approached the hozen and asked them to take the fireworks at Morning Breeze Village so that she could play with Kee Kee, Huk Huk obliged. Some time after taking the fireworks and moving them to the village, he was confronted by Aysa Cloudsinger, Ji Firepaw, and a pandaren champion about the fireworks. He insisted he did not steal them and had to fight the champion. He halted the duel, took the visitors to the western part of the village to see where the fireworks were, and reaffirmed that he had not stolen them, as they were wanted by the kids.
